subject: third-story apartment
fact: The third-story apartment in Janussi's chambers has an open door and was unvisited.
source_quote: There's something listed as a third-story apartment with an open door we haven't gone into.

subject: wrapping paper from the poisoned book
fact: The wrapping paper that had wrapped the poisoned book had been taken to the third-story apartment.
source_quote: We knew the wrapping paper from the poisoned book had been taken there.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist is dragonborn and had burnt something at the feast.
source_quote: When you talk to Alkrist, there's something in the list about what Alkrist burned at the feast — you should ask about that.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch is the First Reader who developed the Threefold Proof methodology, which Janussi dismissed as solipsism.
source_quote: Kalan Strongbranch. The First Reader. The one with the truth-seeking spell that had already anchored the investigation once.

subject: Sylvira
fact: Sylvira is framed for Janussi’s murder and is dying slowly under poison’s effect.
source_quote: Sylvira was framed for the murder and dying slowly under the poison's effect.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a drow investigator chosen to interview Sylvira due to his skill in eliciting testimony.
source_quote: Daz was the natural choice for it: he knew how to make someone talk, and he was drow, which was not irrelevant given what we knew about the Menzoberranzan thread running under all of this.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is investigating the third-story apartment and discovered Janussi’s critical review of Kalan’s proposal.
source_quote: Grygum headed upstairs for the physical evidence.

subject: Fembris
fact: Fembris is hunting Kalan Strongbranch to enable the Alkrist interview with binding evidence.
source_quote: I'm gonna have to hunt Kalan down," he said, the energy of a man who locates missing First Readers as a matter of routine.

subject: Janussi’s note
fact: Janussi’s note dismissed Kalan’s Threefold Proof as solipsism, writing that crime investigation was an indulgence for Kalan’s personal entertainment.
source_quote: Janussi had reviewed Kalan Strongbranch's proposal for new criminal investigation methodologies, found it to be solipsism, and had blocked it. He wasn't interested... in creating all these rules and procedures so that Kalan could go detect a murder mystery.

subject: Sylvira’s quarters
fact: Sylvira’s quarters contain a faux fireplace blazing with full spell force, yet she shudders from an unrelenting cold.
source_quote: A faux fireplace blazed along one wall, throwing out heat with the single-mindedness of a spell running at full force, yet Sylvira kept shuddering anyway.

subject: Kazryn Nyantani
fact: Kazryn Nyantani was Janussi’s former lover and resented Sylvira for replacing her.
source_quote: That bitter old hag... who always resented Janussi for ditching her in favor of me.

subject: Daral Yashenti
fact: Daral Yashenti is a drunk poet who sold his worthless poetry to fund a new library and was dismissed by Sylvira as incapable of the murder’s planning.
source_quote: A drunk who is bitter... too much of a drunk to pull off something like that.

subject: the feast burning
fact: Alkrist burnt something at the feast — an act referenced in the investigation notes as potentially binding evidence.
source_quote: He apparently burnt something at the feast," came the confirmation. "That's what it says.

subject: Sylvira’s final words with Janussi
fact: Sylvira’s final words with Janussi were spoken during an argument, moments before his death.
source_quote: Those were my last words with him.

subject: Kalan’s proposal rejection
fact: Kalan’s Threefold Proof methodology was formally blocked by Janussi, derailing his career and possibly motivating his actions.
source_quote: All of it. Dismissed as solipsism. Shelved.

subject: Janussi's chambers
fact: Janussi's chambers contain a third-story apartment that holds evidence of his private scholarly habits and critical notes.
source_quote: Janussi's chambers. I'd been in the lower floors. We all had. But the third story had sat there like an unopened file.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is absent from Sylvira’s interview, preparing to confront Alkrist.
source_quote: Thorin wasn't in the room to offer the easy sympathy. He was off somewhere getting ready to make Alkrist very uncomfortable.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is referenced as having no patience for unaccounted time, and would have closed the gap Sylvira left in her alibi.
source_quote: It was the kind of gap Zalthir would have wanted closed before moving on.

subject: the interview with Sylvira
fact: Daz interviewed Sylvira, who admitted to being framed and named Kazryn Nyantani as a suspect, while revealing her infernal heritage and the prejudice she faced.
source_quote: She started thinking aloud about suspects... 'This was my fault.'... 'Being the convenient target isn't exclusive to any one city.'

subject: Grygum’s discovery of Janussi’s note
fact: Grygum discovered Janussi’s note, which revealed that Janussi had not only rejected Kalan’s methodology but had characterized it as a vanity project.
source_quote: Janussi hadn't just rejected the proposal. He'd characterized Kalan's entire framework as a vanity project... as though the investigation of crime were an indulgence, a hobby, a *conceit* Kalan was pursuing for his own entertainment.
